sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99% Invisible。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: If you've wandered at Machu Picchu or Stonehenge or the Colosseum or even snuck into that abandoned house on the edge of town,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾漫步于马丘比丘、巨石阵、罗马斗兽场，甚至溜进过镇边缘那栋废弃的房子，

sentences.en: you know the power in a piece of decrepit architecture.
sentences.zh: 你就会明白残破建筑所蕴含的力量。

sentences.en: Even if you haven't been to these places, they've been photographed and filmed for you.
sentences.zh: 即便你从未去过这些地方，你也一定看过它们的照片和影像。

sentences.en: Abandoned Soviet bus stops, deserted old movie theaters, decaying residential streets.
sentences.zh: 废弃的苏联公交车站、荒凉的老电影院、日渐破败的住宅街道。

sentences.en: They're fascinating in this, like, Planet of the Apes kind of way.
sentences.zh: 它们有一种迷人的魅力，就像《人猿星球》那种风格。

sentences.en: So, of course, there's a German word for it.
sentences.zh: 所以，德语里当然有一个专门的词来形容这种现象。

sentences.en: RuinenluSt. The long-standing aesthetic obsession with decay.
sentences.zh: Ruinenlust。一种长期以来对废墟衰败的审美迷恋。

sentences.en: Resident Germanophile and producer Avery Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 常驻德国文化爱好者兼制作人艾维·特罗费尔曼。

sentences.en: It might actually be one of those made-up German words.
sentences.zh: 这其实可能是那些生造出来的德语词之一。

sentences.en: It probably is.
sentences.zh: 很可能就是这样。

sentences.en: But the concept itself is totally a real thing.
sentences.zh: 但这个概念本身绝对是真实存在的。

sentences.en: Ruins inspire wonder.
sentences.zh: 废墟能激发人们的惊叹之情。

sentences.en: They give the mind this task of reconciling what's there and what's not.
sentences.zh: 它们让大脑去调和眼前的现实与消逝的过去。

sentences.en: What once was and what now is.
sentences.zh: 曾经的模样与如今的形态。

sentences.en: People flock to remainders of ancient civilizations.
sentences.zh: 人们蜂拥至古代文明的遗迹前。

sentences.en: Romans, the Mayans, the Egyptians.
sentences.zh: 罗马人、玛雅人、埃及人。

sentences.en: But people also flock to things that just look like they're ancient, too.
sentences.zh: 但人们也会蜂拥至那些看起来像是古代遗迹的事物前。

sentences.en: That combination of decomposition and romance makes a perfect cocktail of repulsion and allure.
sentences.zh: 这种分解与浪漫的结合，完美融合了排斥感与吸引力。

sentences.en: And for San Franciscans, this place is Sutro Baths.
sentences.zh: 对于旧金山人来说，这个地方就是苏特罗浴场。

sentences.en: My friend Austin brought me there one night.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友奥斯汀有一天晚上带我去了那里。

sentences.en: So how do you get in?
sentences.zh: 那么怎么进去呢？

sentences.en: Does the trail just lead right to it?
sentences.zh: 这条小路是直接通往那里吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: There's steps.
sentences.zh: 有台阶。

sentences.en: There's a parking lot up there and steps that go down.
sentences.zh: 上面有个停车场，有台阶通下去。

sentences.en: Head to the rocks at Land's End on the very northwest corner of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 前往旧金山最西北角的兰兹角岩石区。

sentences.en: Walk down the flight of stairs into a grassy slope that hugs the sea.
sentences.zh: 走下一段楼梯，进入一片紧邻大海的草坡。

sentences.en: Off to the right is the gaping maw of a cave.
sentences.zh: 右边是一个张着大口的洞穴。

sentences.en: To your left is the crumbled foundation of a concrete structure.
sentences.zh: 左边是混凝土建筑崩塌的地基。

sentences.en: It looks like a giant Belgian waffle, about 7 feet tall and 50 feet wide on the longest side.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像个巨大的比利时华夫饼，长边约有50英尺，高约7英尺。

sentences.en: Beside the waffle are two pools of still water with a concrete jetty between them that dares you to walk its length.
sentences.zh: 华夫饼状建筑旁有两个平静的水池，中间有一条混凝土栈道，引诱着你去走上一遭。

sentences.en: Make it to the end and you're at a seawall where the Pacific Ocean crashes into the rocks.
sentences.zh: 走到尽头，你就会来到防波堤，太平洋的巨浪正猛烈地拍打着岩石。

sentences.en: There's no fence.
sentences.zh: 没有栅栏。

sentences.en: No guards.
sentences.zh: 没有警卫。

sentences.en: Only a warning sign that says,
sentences.zh: 只有一块警告牌，上面写着：

sentences.en: What you can see down here are the ruins of the bathhouses.
sentences.zh: 你在这里能看到的是浴场的废墟。

sentences.en: Have you heard any rumors as to what was what here?
sentences.zh: 你有没有听到过关于这里以前是什么地方的传言？

sentences.en: Strangely, no.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，没有。

sentences.en: I mean, other than it's a bathhouse in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了知道这是旧金山的一个浴场之外。

sentences.en: With all that might indicate.
sentences.zh: 以及由此可能暗示的一切。

sentences.en: Well, not the kind of San Francisco bathhouse he's thinking of.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可不是他脑子里想的那种旧金山浴场。

sentences.en: If he's thinking of what I think he's thinking of.
sentences.zh: 如果他想的是我认为他想的那种的话。

sentences.en: But we'll get back to that in a minute.
sentences.zh: 但我们一会儿再谈这个。

sentences.en: And last time you were here, it was just like,
sentences.zh: 你上次来这里的时候，情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: were people wondering about the history of it at all?
sentences.zh: 大家对它的历史会感到好奇吗？

sentences.en: No, it was like 300 punks in a cave.
sentences.zh: 不，当时就像是有300个朋克青年挤在一个洞穴里。

sentences.en: Austin had seen a band playing in the cave.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀看到一支乐队在山洞里演出。

sentences.en: They plugged their amps into a generator that they brought themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们把扩音器插在自己带来的发电机上。

sentences.en: He told me things like that were happening at Sutra Baths all the time.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我说，苏特罗浴场经常发生这种事。

sentences.en: And it's easy to see why.
sentences.zh: 这很容易理解原因。

sentences.en: This place has a draw.
sentences.zh: 这个地方有一种吸引力。

sentences.en: The night that I was there,
sentences.zh: 我去的那个晚上，

sentences.en: a group of photographers was snapping shots of the moon.
sentences.zh: 有一群摄影师在拍月亮。

sentences.en: Is this like a known photo destination?
sentences.zh: 这里算是一个热门的摄影胜地吗？

sentences.en: I would say the last three years has been more common.
sentences.zh: 我可以说过去三年里这种情况更常见了。

sentences.en: So I think people are finding out about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想人们正在逐渐了解这个地方。

sentences.en: I just know that in the 30s,
sentences.zh: 我只知道在20世纪30年代，

sentences.en: it was some sort of bath for people to sit in and just soak.
sentences.zh: 这里某种程度上是供人们坐着泡澡放松的地方。

sentences.en: I don't know if it was hot or cold or what it was about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道水是热的还是冷的，也不知道这究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Ruins have drawn people to them for centuries.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，废墟一直吸引着人们。

sentences.en: Starting in the late 1600s,
sentences.zh: 从17世纪末开始，

sentences.en: a tradition emerged among European men of means to go visit sites of antiquity,
sentences.zh: 欧洲富有阶层的男子中兴起了一种传统，即前往古代遗址参观，

sentences.en: Paris, Venice, Rome, and learn about the roots of Western civilization.
sentences.zh: 巴黎、威尼斯、罗马，并了解西方文明的根源。

sentences.en: Today, lots of people visit what's left of the old world.
sentences.zh: 如今，许多人都会去参观旧世界的遗迹。

sentences.en: People like ruins.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢废墟。

sentences.en: It gives us a sense of time passing, maybe a sense of place.
sentences.zh: 它带给我们一种时间流逝的感觉，或许还有一种地域感。

sentences.en: Why do people go to ancient Egypt?
sentences.zh: 人们为什么要去古埃及？

sentences.en: Why do they go to the Acropolis?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要去卫城？

sentences.en: A sense of time gone by, a sense of timelessness.
sentences.zh: 为了逝去的时间感，为了永恒感。

sentences.en: And I think also that urge to try to explain what people are looking at.
sentences.zh: 我也认为这是一种试图解释眼前事物的冲动。

sentences.en: Anytime you go out to Sutra Baths,
sentences.zh: 每当你去苏特罗浴场时，

sentences.en: I mean, there's people crawling all over the ruins like ants.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到处都是人在废墟上像蚂蚁一样爬来爬去。

sentences.en: But the thing about these ruins, at the edge of the continent,
sentences.zh: 但关于这些废墟，在大陆的边缘，

sentences.en: they may look ancient, but they really aren't at all.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来可能很古老，但其实一点也不古老。

sentences.en: You talk to them, they're all trying to figure the place out.
sentences.zh: 你跟他们交谈，他们都在试图弄明白这个地方。

sentences.en: What is this where these tunnels do?
sentences.zh: 这是什么？这些隧道通向哪里？

sentences.en: What's this thing?
sentences.zh: 这个东西是什么？

sentences.en: There's a curiosity to it.
sentences.zh: 这里有一种好奇心。

sentences.en: They know they're ruins.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这是废墟。

sentences.en: If they know the name Sutra Baths, they know there were swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道“苏特罗浴场”这个名字，他们就知道这里曾有游泳池。

sentences.en: And that's about it.
sentences.zh: 也就仅此而已了。

sentences.en: This is historian John Martini.
sentences.zh: 这位是历史学家约翰·马蒂尼。

sentences.en: Martini wrote a book about this place called Sutra's Glass Palace.
sentences.zh: 马蒂尼写了一本关于这个地方的书，名叫《苏特罗的玻璃宫殿》。

sentences.en: So named because this pool of water used to be underneath an enormous glass structure.
sentences.zh: 之所以这样命名，是因为这个水池过去位于一个巨大的玻璃结构下方。

sentences.en: And it was the pet project of Adolf Sutra.
sentences.zh: 这是阿道夫·苏特罗的心爱项目。

sentences.en: The name Sutra might sound familiar to you, especially if you live in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: “苏特罗”这个名字你可能觉得耳熟，特别是如果你住在旧金山的话。

sentences.en: There's Sutra Tower, Sutra Heights.
sentences.zh: 这里有苏特罗塔、苏特罗高地。

sentences.en: There's a Sutra library at the San Francisco State University.
sentences.zh: 旧金山州立大学还有一个苏特罗图书馆。

sentences.en: All named after this one German immigrant.
sentences.zh: 都是以这位德国移民的名字命名的。

sentences.en: He struck it rich by engineering a mining tunnel during the Nevada silver strike in the 1860s.
sentences.zh: 他在19世纪60年代内华达州的白银开采热潮中，通过设计一条矿山隧道而发了大财。

sentences.en: And he turned his money into San Francisco real estate.
sentences.zh: 他把赚来的钱投入到了旧金山的房地产中。

sentences.en: A lot of real estate.
sentences.zh: 大量的房地产。

sentences.en: Some historians estimate that at one point Adolf Sutra owned one twelfth of the city.
sentences.zh: 一些历史学家估计，阿道夫·苏特罗曾一度拥有这座城市十二分之一的土地。

sentences.en: Adolf Sutra was to San Francisco what John D.
sentences.zh: 阿道夫·苏特罗对旧金山的影响，就像约翰·D·

sentences.en: Rockefeller was to New York and what Henry Huntington was to L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒对纽约，亨利·亨廷顿对洛杉矶一样。

sentences.en: Sutra built public gardens, presented free concerts, and built the structure that would eventually become Sutra Baths.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗修建了公共花园，举办免费音乐会，并建造了最终成为苏特罗浴场的建筑。

sentences.en: Sutra's original idea was that he wanted to build a giant outdoor aquarium that would be filled by the tides and it would empty at low tide.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗最初的想法是建造一个巨大的户外水族馆，由涨潮时注水，退潮时排空。

sentences.en: So in 1884, he created a catch basin that refilled naturally as the waves broke in.
sentences.zh: 因此，在1884年，他建造了一个蓄水池，随着海浪拍打而自然重新蓄水。

sentences.en: And then Sutra kept making more and more plans, adding on and on to his aquarium.
sentences.zh: 然后苏特罗制定了越来越多计划，不断为他的水族馆添砖加瓦。

sentences.en: He built the network of swimming pools, connecting canals.
sentences.zh: 他修建了游泳池网络和连接的运河。

sentences.en: He even built a powerhouse as a freestanding building to heat the water.
sentences.zh: 他甚至建造了一座独立的动力室来为水加热。

sentences.en: Then, when all that was done, then he hires an architectural firm.
sentences.zh: 然后，当这一切都完成之后，他才聘请了一家建筑事务所。

sentences.en: Assembly would be like if some crazy self-improvement guy built the foundation for an elaborate house,
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个疯狂的自我提升狂人打好了一栋复杂房子的地基，

sentences.en: but didn't know what the house was going to look like.
sentences.zh: 却根本不知道这房子最终会长什么样。

sentences.en: He just built a foundation and he plumbed it.
sentences.zh: 他只是建了地基并铺好了管道。

sentences.en: And then you hire an architect to come in and make a building fit on top of what was already there.
sentences.zh: 然后你再请建筑师来，让一栋建筑恰好契合在已有的基础上。

sentences.en: That's how the baths were designed.
sentences.zh: 这就是浴场的设计过程。

sentences.en: From the outside, Sutra Baths looked like an ornate, palatial greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 从外观上看，苏特罗浴场就像是一个华丽的宫殿式温室。

sentences.en: Underneath its majestic three-tiered glass canopy were several different swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 在其雄伟的三层玻璃穹顶下有几个不同的游泳池。

sentences.en: Hot water and cold, salt water and fresh.
sentences.zh: 热水和冷水，海水和淡水。

sentences.en: And there were more than 500 individual changing rooms beneath the sweeping arena-style bleachers.
sentences.zh: 在倾斜的古罗马竞技场式看台下方，有500多个独立的更衣室。

sentences.en: And attached to the baths was a museum full of Sutra's crazy collection of stuff from around the world.
sentences.zh: 浴场旁边还有一个博物馆，里面摆满了苏特罗从世界各地收集来的各种疯狂藏品。

sentences.en: Miniature boats, model buildings, taxidermied animals, gems, mechanical figures, a real Egyptian mummy.
sentences.zh: 微型船只、建筑模型、动物标本、宝石、机械玩偶，甚至还有一具真正的埃及木乃伊。

sentences.en: All inside of a glass palace facing the ocean at the edge of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在这座面朝大海、位于旧金山边缘的玻璃宫殿里。

sentences.en: Up the hill, towards the road, was a street called Merry Way.
sentences.zh: 顺着山坡往上走，朝向马路的方向，有一条街叫“欢乐路”。

sentences.en: There was a Firth wheel.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个费思轮。

sentences.en: Basically, a Ferris wheel.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是摩天轮。

sentences.en: Along with a roller coaster and a hall of mirrors and games of chance.
sentences.zh: 还有过山车、镜厅和投机游戏。

sentences.en: And keep in mind, Sutra was building at the edge of nowhere, on the rocks by the sea.
sentences.zh: 请记住，苏特罗当时是在不毛之地的边缘、海边的礁石上进行建造。

sentences.en: And public transit didn't go there.
sentences.zh: 而且公共交通根本不到那里。

sentences.en: And this was a challenge for both construction workers and for customers.
sentences.zh: 这对建筑工人和顾客来说都是一个挑战。

sentences.en: It lost money from the day it opened.
sentences.zh: 它从开业的第一天起就开始亏损。

sentences.en: It was a huge white elephant.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的累赘。

sentences.en: It cost Adolph Sutra about a million dollars when it opened in 1894.
sentences.zh: 1894年开业时，它花掉了阿道夫·苏特罗大约100万美元。

sentences.en: And you put that today, that's $37, $40 million.
sentences.zh: 换算到今天，那就是3700万到4000万美元。

sentences.en: It couldn't make money from charging people 10 cents to get in and 15 cents to go swimming.
sentences.zh: 它不可能仅靠收10美分门票和15美分游泳费来盈利。

sentences.en: It would have had to be packed almost every day.
sentences.zh: 它必须几乎每天都爆满才行。

sentences.en: And in an attempt to pack the house, Sutra poured even more money into electric rail lines that led out to the baths.
sentences.zh: 为了让浴场爆满，苏特罗投入了更多的资金修建通往浴场的有轨电车线路。

sentences.en: This was a huge boom for the city's mass transit.
sentences.zh: 这对城市的公共交通是一个巨大的推动。

sentences.en: At the same time, remember, he owned all the land surrounding it that people were going to be traveling through.
sentences.zh: 同时请记住，人们前往那里时必须穿过他周围拥有的所有土地。

sentences.en: And there were always advertisements for the Sutra Land Company where they're trying to sell land.
sentences.zh: 当时总有苏特罗土地公司的广告，试图出售土地。

sentences.en: So he's doing things for the public at the same time trying to make some money.
sentences.zh: 所以他一方面在为公众做好事，另一方面也试图赚点钱。

sentences.en: But Sutra baths just never, ever made money.
sentences.zh: 但苏特罗浴场却从未、从来没有赚过钱。

sentences.en: By the time Adolph Sutra was elected mayor in 1894, his beloved baths were still not turning a profit.
sentences.zh: 到1894年阿道夫·苏特罗当选市长时，他深爱的浴场依然没有盈利。

sentences.en: When he died four years later in 1898, his family started looking to get rid of the property.
sentences.zh: 四年后的1898年他去世时，他的家人开始想要脱手这处房产。

sentences.en: The Sutra family tried for years to sell Sutra baths, while also trying valiantly to make it turn a profit.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗家族多年来一直在试图出售苏特罗浴场，同时也在英勇地试图让它扭亏为盈。

sentences.en: In 1934, my father was hired by Adolph Sutra, who is the grandson of the pioneer Adolph Sutra.
sentences.zh: 1934年，我父亲受雇于阿道夫·苏特罗，也就是先驱阿道夫·苏特罗的孙子。

sentences.en: Just about that time, Adolph Sutra wanted to do something to get more people out here.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，阿道夫·苏特罗想要做点什么来吸引更多人来到这里。

sentences.en: If you go to Sutra baths, you may run into Tom Bratton.
sentences.zh: 如果你去苏特罗浴场，你可能会遇到汤姆·布拉顿。

sentences.en: My name is Tom Bratton, and now I volunteer for the natural parks and come out here once a week and for a few hours
sentences.zh: 我叫汤姆·布拉顿，现在我是国家公园的志愿者，每周来这里几个小时，

sentences.en: and talk to people and let them know just exactly what all these ruins were about.
sentences.zh: 跟人们交谈，让他们确切了解所有这些废墟的背景。

sentences.en: Tom's father was an engineer, and he helped Sutra baths undergo its really wiggy midlife crisis.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的父亲是一名工程师，他曾协助苏特罗浴场经历了一次真正古怪的中年危机。

sentences.en: They cut off the bottom pool, cut that off from the regular pool, drained it, scattered sand around on it,
sentences.zh: 他们把底部的泳池切断，将其与常规泳池隔开，把水抽干，在上面撒了些沙子，

sentences.en: put in some tables, ping pong tables and picnic tables, and they called that the Tropic Beach.
sentences.zh: 摆上一些桌子，乒乓球桌和野餐桌，他们把这叫做“热带海滩”。

sentences.en: The Tropic Beach was supposed to be a warm, sandy place indoors just to hang out,
sentences.zh: 热带海滩本应是一个温暖、室内沙滩式的休闲场所，

sentences.en: even though the real beach was right outside.
sentences.zh: 尽管真正的海滩就在外面。

sentences.en: That really didn't work out too well.
sentences.zh: 这个想法效果其实并不是很好。

sentences.en: Which really is a shame, because right outside, the beach is freezing and usually foggy.
sentences.zh: 这真的很遗憾，因为外面真正的海滩又冷又经常起雾。

sentences.en: A tropical version isn't that crazy.
sentences.zh: 热带风格的设想其实并不算疯狂。

sentences.en: And so they said, well, how about this?
sentences.zh: 于是他们说，嗯，这个主意怎么样？

sentences.en: We'll take that Tropic Beach away, and we'll put a platform there, and we'll make that into an ice rink.
sentences.zh: 我们把那个热带海滩撤掉，在那里建一个平台，把它改成滑冰场。

sentences.en: And when Tom was in high school, his father got him a job working at this very ice rink.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆上高中时，他父亲帮他在这个冰场找了一份工作。

sentences.en: Yes, Tom worked at this place while it was still standing, which seems impossible, given how ancient the ruins look.
sentences.zh: 是的，汤姆在这个地方还在的时候就在这里工作了，考虑到这些遗迹看起来有多古老，这似乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: People will really come up to me and say, were these really ruins from Rome?
sentences.zh: 人们真的会走到我面前说，这些真的是来自罗马的遗迹吗？

sentences.en: And I say, not really.
sentences.zh: 我说，其实并不是。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: Tom's just being nice.
sentences.zh: 汤姆只是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: By the time Tom was employed there, the name of the place had changed, from Sutro Baths to just Sutros.
sentences.zh: 到汤姆在那里工作时，这个地方的名字已经从苏特罗浴场改成了苏特罗。

sentences.en: The Sutro family had finally gotten rid of this place in 1952, when entertainment tycoon George Whitney bought it.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗家族最终在1952年摆手不管了，当时娱乐大亨乔治·惠特尼买下了它。

sentences.en: Whitney was the boss when Tom Bratton started as a locker attendant.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆·布拉顿开始担任存衣处服务员时，惠特尼就是老板。

sentences.en: And even more than the Sutro family, George Whitney was really trying to do everything he could to get people to come out.
sentences.zh: 与苏特罗家族相比，乔治·惠特尼更是千方百计地想吸引人们来这里。

sentences.en: So he tacked on more amusements, including a ride high above the sea that shuttled between the two cliffs on either side of Sutros.
sentences.zh: 因此他增添了更多游乐设施，包括一条高悬在海面上、往返于苏特罗两侧悬崖之间的缆车。

sentences.en: He called it the Sky Tram.
sentences.zh: 他把它叫做空中缆车。

sentences.en: The Sky Tram.
sentences.zh: 空中缆车。

sentences.en: This thing would hold about 20 people.
sentences.zh: 这东西大约能容纳20人。

sentences.en: It took about 20 minutes to get across.
sentences.zh: 过河大约需要20分钟。

sentences.en: So they didn't make a lot of money on it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有靠它赚到大钱。

sentences.en: Whitney also thought an aviary might bring in the big money, so he ordered some exotic birds in some cages.
sentences.zh: 惠特尼还认为鸟舍能带来大笔财富，于是他订购了一些关在笼子里的珍奇鸟类。

sentences.en: What happened was all the birds came in at once before the cages.
sentences.zh: 结果所有的鸟都在笼子到货之前一下子全运到了。

sentences.en: So Whitney called all the employees and said, okay, everybody here, take home a bird until our cages come in and then we'll bring the birds back.
sentences.zh: 于是惠特尼召集了所有员工说，好了，这里的每个人，带一只鸟回家，等我们的笼子到了，我们再把鸟带回来。

sentences.en: What a mess.
sentences.zh: 真是个烂摊子。

sentences.en: But even after the ice rink and the aviary and the Sky Tram, people still weren't coming to Sutros.
sentences.zh: 但即使有了滑冰场、鸟舍和空中缆车，人们依然不愿光顾苏特罗。

sentences.en: The Whitney's, after struggling for 14 years, decided we're going to sell the property.
sentences.zh: 惠特尼一家在苦苦支撑14年后，决定将这处房产出售。

sentences.en: Historian John Martini, again.
sentences.zh: 再次请出历史学家约翰·马蒂尼。

sentences.en: It was sold to a land developer who began to demolish it.
sentences.zh: 它被卖给了一位开始拆除它的土地开发商。

sentences.en: And in June 66, that's when the very convenient fire broke out.
sentences.zh: 在66年6月，一场非常“凑巧”的大火爆发了。

sentences.en: In 1966, a mysterious fire broke out and reduced Sutros to a pile of rubble.
sentences.zh: 1966年，一场神秘的大火爆发，将苏特罗化为一片废墟。

sentences.en: An arsonist was suspected, but no one was arrested.
sentences.zh: 有人怀疑是纵火犯干的，但没有人被捕。

sentences.en: And then Sutros was just never rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 随后苏特罗就再也没有重建过。

sentences.en: Eventually, the last owner sold the land to the National Park Service in 1980.
sentences.zh: 最终，最后一任业主于1980年将土地卖给了国家公园管理局。

sentences.en: So it's part of a big national park area.
sentences.zh: 所以它是大型国家公园区域的一部分。

sentences.en: Sutro Baths is right inside Golden Gate National Recreation Area.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗浴场就位于金门国家游憩区内。

sentences.en: And when the government finally bought it, it was seamlessly included into this big national park area.
sentences.zh: 当政府最终买下它时，它被无缝并入了这片巨大的国家公园区域。

sentences.en: It's not a national park itself.
sentences.zh: 它本身并不是一个国家公园。

sentences.en: And it doesn't look like it belongs within the Golden Gate National Park's conservancy at all.
sentences.zh: 而且它看起来一点也不像是属于金门国家公园保护区的东西。

sentences.en: It just looks like a bunch of ruins.
sentences.zh: 它看起来只是一堆废墟。

sentences.en: Sometimes ruins are more evocative than if the site is restored.
sentences.zh: 有时废墟比恢复原貌的遗址更能引起共鸣。

sentences.en: Because there's more of a sense that this is the real deal.
sentences.zh: 因为人们更有这才是真家伙的感觉。

sentences.en: Even though these are only 45 years old, they have the same attraction.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些建筑只有45年的历史，但它们有着同样的吸引力。

sentences.en: That urge to try to explain what people are looking at.
sentences.zh: 那种试图解释人们正在看什么的冲动。

sentences.en: Other ruins, remains of Sutro Baths are less than 50 years old.
sentences.zh: 其他遗迹，也就是苏特罗浴场的残余，至今不到50年历史。

sentences.en: They are part of a national park.
sentences.zh: 它们是国家公园的一部分。

sentences.en: Since 2012, they do have their own tiny museum and gift shop on site,
sentences.zh: 自2012年以来，它们确实在现场拥有了自己的小型博物馆和礼品店，

sentences.en: right along Mary Way, where the Midway used to be.
sentences.zh: 就在玛丽大道旁，也就是昔日游乐场所在地。

sentences.en: The street sign is still there.
sentences.zh: 路标还在那儿。

sentences.en: And yet, the ruins are still pretty dangerous.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些遗迹仍然相当危险。

sentences.en: And to many people, still mysterious.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，依然充满神秘色彩。

sentences.en: So at this point, you may be wondering how to get out to the baths.
sentences.zh: 所以此时，你可能想知道如何去浴场。

sentences.en: Or about parking availability.
sentences.zh: 或者关心停车位的情况。

sentences.en: Or maybe if you can go hold your photo shoot there.
sentences.zh: 或者也许想知道能否去那里拍个照。

sentences.en: Jill can help.
sentences.zh: 吉尔可以帮忙。

sentences.en: People write to me with,
sentences.zh: 人们写信问我：

sentences.en: Can I have my wedding there?
sentences.zh: 我可以在那里举行婚礼吗？

sentences.en: How can I get there?
sentences.zh: 我怎么去那里？

sentences.en: Can I film my movie there?
sentences.zh: 我可以在那里拍电影吗？

sentences.en: I answer all their questions.
sentences.zh: 我回答他们所有的提问。

sentences.en: Jill Corral runs SutroBaths.com
sentences.zh: 吉尔·科拉尔运营着 SutroBaths.com

sentences.en: And I don't say like,
sentences.zh: 我不会说，

sentences.en: Oh, I'm just this random chick in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 哦，我只是西雅图一个随机的普通女孩。

sentences.en: From Seattle!
sentences.zh: 来自西雅图！

sentences.en: You know, I just respond to their question.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我只是回复他们的问题。

sentences.en: Like, yes, is your wedding party smaller than 30 people?
sentences.zh: 比如，是的，你们的婚礼派对少于30人吗？

sentences.en: Sure, you can have it there.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可以在那里办。

sentences.en: Jill snagged SutroBaths.com in 2000.
sentences.zh: 吉尔在2000年抢注了 SutroBaths.com。

sentences.en: I couldn't believe that the domain was available when it was.
sentences.zh: 当这个域名可用时，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: If you contact SutroBaths on Facebook or Twitter,
sentences.zh: 如果你在 Facebook 或 Twitter 上联系 SutroBaths，

sentences.en: those accounts are also run by Jill in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 这些账号也是由远在西雅图的吉尔运营的。

sentences.en: I love it when people ask me, like,
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢别人问我，比如，

sentences.en: How much does it cost?
sentences.zh: 这要花多少钱？

sentences.en: Can I get in?
sentences.zh: 我能进去吗？

sentences.en: It's just like,
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是，

sentences.en: Just go.
sentences.zh: 直接去吧。

sentences.en: It's never closed.
sentences.zh: 它从不关门。

sentences.en: And unlike Tom Bratton or John Martini,
sentences.zh: 与汤姆·布拉顿或约翰·马蒂尼不同，

sentences.en: who actually both experienced SutroBaths when it was a functioning building,
sentences.zh: 他们俩都曾在苏特罗浴场作为营业场所时亲历过这里，

sentences.en: Jill first encountered the place as a ruin.
sentences.zh: 吉尔最初遇到这个地方时，它已是一片废墟。

sentences.en: I was flown out to San Francisco for a job interview in 1997.
sentences.zh: 1997年，我飞到旧金山参加工作面试。

sentences.en: My main mission was to touch the Pacific Ocean that day before my interview.
sentences.zh: 我的主要任务是在面试前的那天去摸一下太平洋。

sentences.en: I went down there and I stumbled on this just insane playground
sentences.zh: 我走到那里，无意中发现了一个疯狂的游乐场，

sentences.en: of concrete and metal sticking out of the ground.
sentences.zh: 由破土而出的混凝土和金属组成。

sentences.en: I didn't know what the hell it was.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道这到底是什么鬼东西。

sentences.en: It was just pretty much the closest to a magical place I'd found as an adult.
sentences.zh: 它几乎是我成年后找到的最接近魔法地方的存在。

sentences.en: And I fell in love.
sentences.zh: 我坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: I think I will toss my ashes there after I die.
sentences.zh: 我想我死后要把骨灰撒在那里。

sentences.en: Well, I won't.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不会的。

sentences.en: Someone else will.
sentences.zh: 别人会帮我撒的。

sentences.en: Jill actually did bury her two pet lizards there.
sentences.zh: 吉尔实际上把她的两只宠物蜥蜴埋在了那里。

sentences.en: They're in the cave.
sentences.zh: 它们在洞穴里。

sentences.en: The story of SutroBaths didn't exactly shape history.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗浴场的故事并没有确切地塑造历史。

sentences.en: Yes, it helped expand San Francisco public transit.
sentences.zh: 是的，它有助于扩展旧金山的公共交通。

sentences.en: Yes, you can see the ruins briefly in a scene in the movie Herald and Maude.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以在电影《哈罗德和莫德》的一个场景中短暂地看到这些遗迹。

sentences.en: But ultimately, it was a strange glass complex at the edge of the ocean that was destined to fail.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，它是海边一座注定要失败的奇怪玻璃综合体。

sentences.en: And amusements and attractions were constantly added and removed throughout its life.
sentences.zh: 在其存在期间，游乐设施和景点不断地被添加又移除。

sentences.en: But in a city as rapidly gentrifying as San Francisco, in a country as young as the United States,
sentences.zh: 但在像旧金山这样快速中产阶级的城市，在美国这样一个年轻的国家，

sentences.en: these ruins are an anomaly.
sentences.zh: 这些遗迹是个异数。

sentences.en: I respect people's desire for it to be like this mysterious, unknown thing.
sentences.zh: 我尊重人们希望它成为这样一个神秘、未知事物的愿望。

sentences.en: But when I hear tourists talking and just sitting there wondering,
sentences.zh: 但当我听到游客们边走边纳闷时，

sentences.en: like I have been known to walk up to them and tell them like there used to be this giant, beautiful, magical thing here.
sentences.zh: 我有时会忍不住走过去告诉他们，这里曾经有一个巨大、美丽、神奇的地方。

sentences.en: Like you have to know about it.
sentences.zh: 就像你必须了解它一样。

sentences.en: Always read the plaque, right?
sentences.zh: 总得读读牌子，对吧？

sentences.en: You got it.
sentences.zh: 说得对。

sentences.en: In addition to researching what the baths were, Jill keeps tabs on how they're changing.
sentences.zh: 除了研究浴场的过去，吉尔还在密切关注它们的变化。

sentences.en: Ruins seem static, like a fixed ending.
sentences.zh: 废墟似乎是静态的，就像一个固定的结局。

sentences.en: But of course they're not.
sentences.zh: 但它们当然不是。

sentences.en: I have watched it continue to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 我看着它继续分崩离析。

sentences.en: There used to be a deck that you could go and read on by the cave.
sentences.zh: 以前洞穴旁有一个平台，你可以去那里看书。

sentences.en: And then it just crumbled into the sea sometime around 2005.
sentences.zh: 然后在2005年前后，它就坍塌坠入海中了。

sentences.en: It's still living and dying in slow-mo.
sentences.zh: 它仍然在慢动作中经历着生老病死。

sentences.en: Which is a process the parks are actually trying to stop, according to Tom Bratton.
sentences.zh: 据汤姆·布拉顿透露，公园管理方实际上正试图阻止这一进程。

sentences.en: As far as the national parks go, they want to make it so that it's not going to deteriorate anymore than it already has.
sentences.zh: 就国家公园而言，他们希望阻止它进一步恶化。

sentences.en: If it deteriorates anymore, you're not going to really be able to tell what it really was.
sentences.zh: 如果它再恶化下去，你就真的分不清它原本是什么了。

sentences.en: Tom speculates they might do this by adding more signs, maybe stabilizing some of the decaying structures, but not too much more.
sentences.zh: 汤姆推测他们可能会通过增加更多的标志来做到这一点，也许会加固一些正在腐烂的结构，但不会做太多其他事情。

sentences.en: Well, what the parks really don't want to do, they don't want to make it look like a box to go inside and look at the ruins and then come out again.
sentences.zh: 嗯，公园真正不想做的是，他们不想把它弄得像个进去看看遗迹然后又走出来的盒子一样。

sentences.en: But recently, the young ruins have become something else entirely.
sentences.zh: 但最近，这些年轻的遗迹已经完全变成了别的东西。

sentences.en: Nature's reclaiming the site.
sentences.zh: 大自然正在收复这片土地。

sentences.en: The ruins continue to evolve.
sentences.zh: 遗迹仍在继续演变。

sentences.en: The old swimming pools themselves have become partly silted in.
sentences.zh: 旧的游泳池本身已经部分被淤泥填满。

sentences.en: It's become a wetland.
sentences.zh: 这里已经变成了一片湿地。

sentences.en: Migrating birds love the site.
sentences.zh: 候鸟非常喜欢这个地方。

sentences.en: And recently, an otter appeared swimming in Sutro Baths.
sentences.zh: 最近，一只水獭出现在苏特罗浴场里游来游去。

sentences.en: The public dubbed him Sutro Sam.
sentences.zh: 公众给他起了个外号叫苏特罗·山姆。

sentences.en: Sutro Baths continues to be a machine for generating new San Francisco folklore.
sentences.zh: 苏特罗浴场依然是一台不断产生旧金山新民间传说的机器。

sentences.en: Today, Sutro Baths is pretty much back to where it started.
sentences.zh: 如今，苏特罗浴场几乎回到了它最初的起点。

sentences.en: All that remains is the foundation, including the original catch basin that Adolf Sutro built
sentences.zh: 剩下的只有地基，包括阿道夫·苏特罗在构思游泳池、热带海滩、狂欢节游乐场、溜冰场之前建造的原始集水池。

sentences.en: before ever imagining a swimming pool, a tropic beach, a carnival midway, an ice skating rink.
sentences.zh: 所以，在历经多年建造这座奇迹宫殿、添加游戏游乐设施和奇观之后，

sentences.en: So after all the years of building this palace of wonder after adding games and rides and oddities,
sentences.zh: 在经历了一次次尝试却未能吸引公众来到海边这个奇怪地方之后，

sentences.en: trying and failing to draw the public out to this strange place by the ocean,
sentences.zh: 阿道夫·苏特罗或乔治·惠特尼所需要做的，只是任由它付之一炬并化为废墟。

sentences.en: all Adolf Sutro or George Whitney had to do was let it burn down and crumble into ruin.
sentences.zh: 本周的《百分之九十九隐形》由艾弗瑞·特鲁夫曼制作，萨姆·格林斯潘、

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffleman with Sam Greenspan,
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·明格以及我，罗曼·马斯共同参与。

sentences.en: Katie Mingle, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 地方公共广播电台 KALW 的一个项目，

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心的 ArcSign 办公室制作，

sentences.en: and produced in downtown Oakland, California out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 这是一家非常重视合作的建筑事务所，他们甚至可能和阿道夫·苏特罗共事过。

sentences.en: an architecture firm who values collaboration so much they could have even worked with Adolf Sutro.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解更多关于设计的酷炫小常识或半夜的随机笑话，

sentences.en: If you'd like more cool tidbits about design or random jokes in the middle of the night,
sentences.zh: 可以在 Facebook、Tumblr 和 Twitter 上找到我们。

sentences.en: try finding us on Facebook, Tumblr, and Twitter.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是成千上万错过了众筹而懊恼不已的人之一，

sentences.en: But if you're one of the hundreds of thousands of people who are kicking themselves
sentences.zh: 并且想要一件印有炫目迷彩船图案的《百分之九十九隐形》T恤，

sentences.en: because they missed the Kickstarter and would love a 99% Invisible t-shirt with a Razzle Dazzle ship on it
sentences.zh: 或者印有“总得读读牌子”字样的T恤，

sentences.en: or one that says always read the plaque,
sentences.zh: 请访问 99pi.org 并点击名为“商店”的链接，

sentences.en: go to 99pi.org and click the link that says shop,
sentences.zh: 你就可以炫耀你对广播节目及相关周边商品的高雅品味了。

sentences.en: and you can show off your great taste in radio programs and associated merchandise.
sentences.zh: 迷彩船T恤保证每天至少能引发一次对话。

sentences.en: The Dazzle Ship t-shirt is guaranteed to start at least one conversation a day.
sentences.zh: 绝对保证。

sentences.en: Guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 请点击 99pi.org 上的商店。

sentences.en: Click shop at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 点击99pi.org进行网购。

sentences.en: Radio Tempia.
sentences.zh: 腾皮亚电台。
